items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who, who played drums with Red Allen then? Welner. [INTERVIEWEE] Huh? Who played drums? Well, with Red Allen, with Sonny Allen. Well, at the time when we was planned to be a little boy called Johnny Thomas used to play a drum with us. Uh-huh.

ctx.x: Yeah, Lucci, Lucci used to play around, I used to see him. He played trombone? Yeah, he used to play with John Casmy. Yeah.
